text:
sarah: :rotating_light: paging oncall — policy-engine is throwing runtime panics during routing evals, customers seeing 500s + huge latency spikes. root request 1769990123
sarah: alert shows repeated stack: `panic: invalid type assertion in policy evaluator` then `fallback -> route_to_region(us-east-1)` then another exception and repeat. looks like a loop
incidents-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-1103, severity P1. Notifying on-call.
pagerduty-bot: Paging Devon (oncall) — acknowledge required.
devon: acked. grabbing logs now. what customers impacted?
maria: seeing spikes across hosted-api-prod in us-east-1 & eu-west-1. Some requests keep flipping region and model variant. A few customers report timeouts ~30s.
elena: I can see routing traces: request X -> model: gptx-2-raw -> policy eval panics -> fallback to variant: gptx-2-compat -> policy tries region fallback -> eval panics again -> hits circuit breaker -> retry -> same. looks like policy hit invalid expression for variant selection when kv is missing.
sarah: is there any recent policy change?
james: I rolled out a small policy tweak 30m ago to add a guard: `if request.metadata.env == "prod" && model.tags includes "gpu" { route=best }` — maybe the `includes` helper isn't always defined.
devon: patch looks suspect. can we pause policy engine or roll back the rule?
maria: We can flip smart-routing to safe-mode which will pin to default model/region. that should stop the loop. Anyone want to run the safe toggle?
elena: I have the toggle script. Command: `./ops/toggles/set_smart_routing_mode.sh --mode=safe --scope=hosted-api-prod`
devon: run it. I'll watch.
(elapsed 45s)
deploy-bot: execute: `./ops/toggles/set_smart_routing_mode.sh --mode=safe --scope=hosted-api-prod` by elena — success.
maria: traffic now pinned to model `gptx-2-compat` in us-west-2. early signs: 500s dropping, p95 latency improving.
sarah: good. keep an eye for retries / backlog. we still need to fix the policy expression and rollout safely.
james: rolling back my policy change now. will push a sanitized version without `includes` helper.
elena: pushing policy rollback: `policy_engine.apply --file policies/routing/remove_includes_guard.json --dry-run=false`
(elapsed 2m)
incidents-bot: policy_engine.apply finished with status OK.
devon: confirm that evals no longer panic — I've instrumented a small probe that sends synthetic requests. results: no panics for 2 minutes, routing stable.
maria: customers still on restored path, but we observed a small subset who saw duplicate charges due to retries — finance/sales notified.
sarah: notify support and account execs for any affected customers. create a mitigation ticket to assess billing impact.
james: root cause: guard used helper `includes` which is implemented in policy runtime as a dynamic call that returns nil on missing metadata; the policy assumed boolean -> caused type assertion panic when converting nil to array. Fix: use `has_tag(request, "gpu")` helper and add nil checks.
elena: I'll open a PR with tests against nil metadata. also adding a runtime patch to make policy evaluator more defensive so expressions don't panic — convert type assert to safe cast.
devon: what's next for remediation and rollback? timeline?
sarah: short-term: keep safe-mode for next 30m while we validate policy tests in staging. medium: deploy patched evaluator + rollout gradual policy in canary. long: add automated policy linting in CI to catch dangerous helpers.
maria: I'm drafting customer comms for impacted set. will loop in support.
james: adding a guard in the policy repo: `if request.metadata != null && has_tag(request, "gpu")` and unit tests.
elena: after safe-mode expiration we should route small percent to smart-routing canary and monitor the `policy.panic` metric.
devon: postmortem checklist: collect traces from 175s window, export policy change diff, include pagerduty timeline, capture billing exposure. assigning: devon (ops timeline), james (policy fix), elena (evaluator patch), maria (customer comms), sarah (postmortem lead).
sarah: good. I'll start the postmortem doc and assign follow-ups. link to runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/policy-eval
incidents-bot: Incident INC-2026-1103 -> status: mitigated (safe-mode active).
(elapsed 20m)
sarah: final note before handoff: safe-mode maintains lower throughput — we may hit throughput SLOs. paging for oncall rotation in 1h for handoff.
devon: acknowledged handoff in 1h. will include runbook link and temp rollback commands in rotation notes.
james: PR opened: https://git.internal.redwood/policy/routing/pull/492 — tests added.
elena: will schedule evaluator patch release in next maintenance window if tests pass.
maria: support comms drafted, will send after legal review.
sarah: thanks everyone. closing communication here, full postmortem will be in /sources/slack/postmortems when ready. :white_check_mark:
